answer_1.quote: We propose a synthesizing framework ... to generate ... instructions ... We harvest a 1M-size dataset, SYNTHQUESTIONS, which exhibits higher diversity than other synthesized datasets.

answer_2.quote: We first score them with methods in Section 3 and discard all the instructions whose scores are below 3 ... We assess and visualize the semantic diversity ... Vendi Score ... Lexical diversity calculated with MTLD algorithm.

answer_3.quote: We use LLaMA-3-70B-Instruct as the judging model. For each dimension that an instruction satisfies, 1 score will be added ... We also analyze SYNTHQUESTIONS with LLaMA-Guard-3-8B, detecting potential harmful content.
